stories.title: Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism found dead; family cites sustained abuse
new_facts: New fundraiser for Arday's family and a planned public vigil.
Reveals plagiarism accusation, his 'youngest Black professor' title, and death location in south London.
Family cites a 'campaign of misinformation' that had become too much before Arday's death.
Reports Cambridge ignored a series of warnings about his life story and work.
States Arday resigned days before his death amid intense scrutiny over his academic work.
Gives his age (37) when he became Cambridge's youngest Black professor.
Family describes a 'campaign of sustained abuse' since he took the Cambridge role, beyond earlier misinformation claim.
PM Andy Burnham calls for a 'moment for reflection'; politicians and academics call death a tragedy.
Police say the death does not appear suspicious but is being investigated.
stories.line: Cambridge professor Jason Arday, who faced plagiarism accusations and alleged harassment, has died; his family says he endured sustained abuse since his hire.

stories.title: Massive egg recall issued for salmonella in U.S. south and southwest
new_facts: FDA elevated recall of ~1.6m dozen Texas eggs to highest-risk level amid salmonella outbreak sickening ~100 people.
stories.line: Salmonella contamination has prompted a recall of eggs across southern U.S. states; consumers should check their cartons.

stories.title: Cyclospora outbreak exposes gaps in U.S. food safety system
new_facts: Trump administration delayed a rule last year that could have sped up sourcing the Cyclospora outbreak
stories.line: A parasite outbreak sickened thousands across the U.S. despite food safety systems designed to prevent it.

stories.title: Anthropic adds fading watermarks to Claude text
stories.line: Anthropic is adding watermarks to Claude outputs that fade with editing and skip code, making detection unreliable.

stories.title: Bonnie Tyler remembered as coffin arrives in Welsh hometown
new_facts: Establishes story: Bonnie Tyler's coffin brought home, fans line Welsh village streets to bid farewell
Adds real name Gaynor Hopkins, age 75, death in Portugal hospital July 8, prior induced coma after intestinal surgery, funeral Monday
stories.line: Bonnie Tyler, 1980s rock star behind 'Total Eclipse of the Heart,' died at 75; thousands gathered in her Welsh hometown as her coffin arrived.

stories.title: Democrats move South Carolina to first 2028 primary position
new_facts: DNC officially adopted new 2028 primary calendar: SC first, then Nevada, NH, NM, Michigan, Virginia.
Specifies exact dates: South Carolina Jan. 22, 2028; Nevada Feb. 1, 2028.
stories.line: Democrats moved South Carolina to first position in 2028 primary calendar, shifting early voting power to a state with large Black and Latino populations.
